name: AuthAndDead.401-authentication-error-envelope
why: 401 with llama.cpp authentication_error envelope: status branch (kama-probe.sh:459) fires before any body check -> UNAUTHORIZED_SERVICE http-401.

name: AuthAndDead.403-authentication-error-envelope
why: 403 with llama.cpp authentication_error envelope: status branch (kama-probe.sh:460) fires before any body check -> UNAUTHORIZED_SERVICE http-403.

name: AuthAndDead.401-carrying-loading-envelope
why: 401 whose body is the exact loading envelope: auth branch precedes the new MODEL_LOADING check and the status is not 503 -> stays UNAUTHORIZED_SERVICE http-401, never MODEL_LOADING.

name: AuthAndDead.403-carrying-loading-envelope
why: 403 carrying the loading envelope: same precedence on the other auth code -> UNAUTHORIZED_SERVICE http-403; a body-only MODEL_LOADING matcher would false-pass here.

name: AuthAndDead.401-plain-text-body
why: 401 with a non-JSON body: verdict keys on status alone (kama-probe.sh:459), body content is never consulted -> UNAUTHORIZED_SERVICE http-401.

name: AuthAndDead.closed-port-connection-refused
why: No listener on the port: curl rc=7 maps to DEAD connection-refused (kama-probe.sh:426-430).

name: AuthAndDead.raw-accept-then-close
why: Stub accepts the TCP connection, sends nothing, closes: curl rc=52 empty reply -> NOT_HTTP empty-reply (kama-probe.sh:436-440).
